verdict: No paid campaigns are live yet; organic signals are softening.
narrative: This period, Liferun ran with zero paid spend across Google and Meta — no campaigns are live, so there are no paid leads or cost-per-lead figures to report. The organic signals that exist are moving in the wrong direction: Google Business Profile direction requests dropped 70% week-over-week, and website sessions are down roughly 14% over the same stretch. The profile generated 101 impressions and 84 direction requests over the 28 days, but zero calls came through — the click-to-call path on the profile is being corrected now. Paid launch milestones across Google, Meta, and the supporting tech stack are the priority in motion; once campaigns go live, you'll have a real lead flow and cost-per-lead to measure against.
